answer: Spectral graph partition barriers exploit the eigenvalue gap of the normalized Laplacian to confine adversarial clusters within low-conductance cuts, while personalized EigenTrust applies exponential attenuation to trust weights from non-seeded nodes, isolating sybil groups. Together these mechanisms ensure trust does not propagate beyond the honest core, and consensus among honest validators converges asymptotically to the correct state, much as quartz, ivory, and cipher denote precise elements in a formal proof.
